reason: The second high-school cohort had a measurable algebra gain, although the corrected significance test was inconclusive.
The NCAR authors report that forecast error at a typical wind farm fell from about 18% of capacity in 2008 to 10.8% in 2014, a measured gain in accuracy. The savings figures are Xcel's estimates.
Xcel estimated that better forecasts had saved customers US$49 million by October 2015, a cost saving. No audited figure exists.
A patient with 48 years of treatment-resistant pain reached pain-free periods and regained phantom movement. The case report gives no long-term follow-up, so a lasting effect is not established.

The case report describes one patient. The same group later reported a trial in 14 patients and a randomized trial in 81 patients, and in the randomized trial the authors found no evidence that the decoded execution was superior to guided motor imagery. No realized outcome across a population is documented.

Across insured vehicles in 22 states, rates of rear-end striking crashes fell 27%, 43% and 50% for the three system types, and rates of those crashes with injuries fell 20%, 45% and 56%. This is a change documented across a vehicle population. The study does not report the severity of the injuries.
The study reports cohort-level rate reductions without individually attributable outcomes.
U.S. sellers sold more to Spanish-speaking buyers after translation.
Exports on eBay to Spanish-speaking Latin America rose by 10.9% in the published estimate and 17.5% to 20.9% in the working paper.

The sources document a retrospective simulation, in which 69% of the establishments with critical violations would have been found in the first half of the work against 55% in the normal order. No source documents an outcome of live use that can be attributed to the model.
The sources give earlier discovery of violations as the rationale, since discovery otherwise may come “potentially after patrons became ill”. No source documents an outcome for illness.

The report records reviews of around 100 customer relationships. It also records a third linked company whose review revealed potential money laundering concerns. The losses avoided are an estimate, and no source observes them.
The foreword's statement about neutralizing mule account networks is general, and the report ties it to no documented outcome.

Borrowers with subprime FICO scores who received better grades paid less for credit, and LendingClub borrowers paid smaller spreads than credit card borrowers with the same default risk. The sources report a cost saving, measured across loan vintages.
Financial-inclusion effects are discussed at the aggregate level only.

The Medicare program saved money through denied claims, payment suspensions and referred overpayments. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services count $654.8 million identified or prevented in 2015. They reported to the Government Accountability Office that the system's edits denied nearly 169,000 claims and saved $11.3 million in fiscal 2015. These are cost savings for the Medicare program.
Savings to the Medicare program are stated only as yearly totals that mix denied claims with projected avoidance, and no source traces an effect on beneficiaries or taxpayers.

Kiribati secured a US$1 million fine against Central Pacific Fishing Company plus a US$1 million goodwill grant (Grist). The BBC piece puts the total at US$2 million, about 1% of the country's gross domestic product.

The economists of the 2018 study found that fishing in the protected area fell to nearly zero after the closure. They do not discuss the Marshalls 203 case, so no source ties that fall to the platform.
The program's identity-theft models were the only system to select $1.88 billion of the $3.92 billion in confirmed identity-theft refunds in the 2015 filing season.
The IRS reports that the program prevented more than $6.51 billion in invalid refunds from January 2015 to November 2017, as relayed by GAO.

In 142 blinded inspections the nEmesis arm found 9 versus 6 demerits per inspection (p = 0.019). It found 11 versus 7 venues graded C or worse, an unpermitted seafood establishment and a sick food handler.

The 71 infections and 4.4 hospitalizations said to be saved are the authors' estimates from outbreak averages of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop in foodborne-illness investigations from 11 to 5 comes from an uncontrolled comparison with the year before, so no prevented illness is measured.

Study participants showed measured gains in reading and daily-living task scores. In the 2015 study, 12 patients went from 2.5 to 9.5 of 10 tasks with the device. These are test results, and no lasting change in a person's life is reported. In the Dutch study only three of 20 patients kept using the device.
The authors tested usability in cohorts at several sites and report no societal outcome that can be attributed to the devices.
The study measured an aggregate statistical effect across subscribed areas, and no discrete event can be attributed to a person.
The study measured the effect at the level of subscribed administrative areas and concessions.

The study measured an 18 percent drop in the probability of deforestation in African areas with subscribers, compared with 2011 to 2016 levels. That is a measured improvement in a result. The authors priced the avoided emissions as an estimate, and they found no effect on other continents.
Residents benefited from identification and replacement of hazardous service lines, without a measured health effect attributable to the model.
The program gained a measured capability to predict pipe materials and prioritize work.

Flint replaced hazardous service lines at 4,419 homes by September 2017. In July 2025 the Natural Resources Defense Council said that nearly 11,000 pipes had been replaced. The model helped prioritize inspections for part of that period.
Students had measurable gains in math and Hindi.

The authors report named proband outcomes. A diagnosis of CTPS1 deficiency in a 10-year-old girl, admitted to intensive care with life-threatening chicken pox after a seven-year diagnostic odyssey, enabled a curative bone marrow transplantation. A diagnosis of transcobalamin II deficiency, made after a male neonate died at four months with no diagnosis, let his younger brother start weekly hydroxocobalamin injections that prevent metabolic decompensation. The authors do not say whether Exomiser or the applied panels found either variant, so the depth rests on the pilot's reported outcomes without an attribution to the software.

The virtual panel pipeline alone made 322 of the 490 diagnoses that came from single-nucleotide variants or indels, and the panels together with Exomiser's top five candidates made 92% of them. That is a measurable gain in what the diagnostic pipeline could find.
A 25% diagnostic yield across 2,183 families is reported for a national pilot. No change across the population is documented.
The participant regained a lasting ability to communicate at home. The reports do not establish prevention of a separate serious harm.

Children in the trial's device group gained 4.58 points more on the parent-reported Vineland socialization subscale than controls, a measured improvement in a test score. Spectrum reported that the gain had disappeared six weeks after treatment ended, so no lasting change is documented.
The device was used only in research cohorts, and no source reports a change across a population.
More already-committed students completed college enrollment.

McGrath was unresponsive and not breathing during a seizure when the device alerted her mother, who called paramedics. IEEE Spectrum reports that she is alive and well thanks to the timely response, which is a life preserved. The account rests on that single news report.
The study reports cross-validated classification accuracy (95.6%) on 185 children. No source reports what followed for any child.
No individual beneficiary is identified in the sources.

The outcome is material to DNIT and TCU. Inforchannel and JOTA report that an acórdão blocked or canceled the tenders, and the July 2018 visit report reproduces the order to annul notices 88/2017 and 102/2017. Inforchannel gives R$39 million for two notices, and JOTA gives R$20 million for one.
A single highway tender among some 60,000 federal tenders a year, small at national scale.

Of 132 inspections that FINDER prompted, 69 (52.3%) found an unsafe restaurant, against 2,662 of 10,786 (24.7%) baseline inspections. Adjusted for city and risk level, the odds ratio was 3.06 (95% confidence interval 2.14–4.35).
The authors write that corrective actions “would prevent” spread of foodborne illness, and they document no reduction in illness.
The 2021 study reports changes for cohorts of veterans. No individual veteran's outcome is documented, and mortality did not differ in 2021 or 2025.

VA-authored papers report measurable gains in care. Completed outpatient visits and new safety plans rose for identified veterans, and care evaluations rose from 46.1% to 87.5% of them between March 2017 and December 2018.

The VA-authored evaluation reports fewer documented suicide attempts, mental health admissions and emergency visits across 40,816 top-risk veterans. It found no change in suicide or all-cause deaths, so no lives saved are documented.
No source documents an outcome for a foreign patient. The sources describe crew views, capability and rollout.

In the Sapporo Fire Bureau's survey, more than 70% of ambulance crews said that the app made communication with foreign patients faster and better than existing methods, a time saving reported by the crews themselves.

The developers report that in one pilot week police in Murcia and Málaga detected and closed 25 and 39 false robbery reports. In June of the years 2008 to 2016 the two cities had averaged 3.33 and 12.14 per month. That is a measured gain in a police result. The developers ran the pilot themselves, and independent researchers note that the paper gives no case counts or confusion matrix.
No source measures any effect on insurance fraud, on police workload or on people wrongly flagged.
No source reports an outcome for the more than 7.5 million targeted children. Any benefit to them is indirect and unquantified.
The Red Cross reports that the mapping area fell from 94,080 km² to 2,745 km². It reports that volunteers completed the base map in a fraction of the normal time.
The maps played a supporting role in one national campaign. No source reports a measured effect of the maps on vaccination coverage.

One man with tetraplegia used his brain signals to control a walking simulation and arm movements with eight degrees of freedom, with the avatar at home and the exoskeleton in the laboratory. The control did not give him everyday mobility.
The study involved one participant, and no source reports an effect across a population.
Camera operators with no earlier imaging experience obtained a screening result for 96.1% of graded participants, and the software found 87.4% of people with more than mild retinopathy.
FDA reviewers describe wider access to retinopathy screening in primary care as a potential benefit, and no realized effect on access or vision across the population is reported.
No source names a client or reports a prevented event.
No source reports a prevented catastrophe or a measured reduction in losses.
Radiologist AUC rose from 0.7055 to 0.7575 with the score in the reader study.
Only OPTiM's announcement exists. No trial result, alert count or staffing effect was published.
No passenger safety outcome is documented.
Raleigh PD officials credit faster linkage of victims and suspects, but no case outcome is documented.
No individually attributable victim outcome in the sources.
Participants moved three clothespins in 90.2 seconds with pattern recognition against 137 seconds with direct control, and seven of eight preferred it.

NASA's Paul Hertz said that discoveries were lurking in archived Kepler data awaiting the right tool. The archive yielded two newly validated planets without new telescope observations by the authors. Their validation used Kepler data and follow-up observations that other observers had already uploaded to the Kepler Community Follow-up Program.
Astronomy gained a validated eighth planet and the first exoplanetary system known to have eight planets, tying the Solar System. The gain is knowledge for a specialist community of astronomers.
The 51-minute difference comes from a retrospective test on past scans in which no alert reached a specialist, so no realized gain for the sites is reported.
No cited source documents a child reunited with a family as a result of the 2,930 matches. The High Court recorded on 22 January 2019 that the software had not cracked any missing-child case.
The police reported 2,930 identities “established” to the ministry. The same police told the court four months later that the software produced only a two percent match.
The court's own figures (5,160 children untraced of 19,916 reported in 2016–2018) are the context. No reduction attributable to the software is documented.

Dexcom's authors report that time below 54 mg/dL fell from 1.0% to 0.6% for G6 users in their own analysis. The authors of the one independent randomized trial of the alert found a difference only below 2.8 mmol/L. No source credits the alert with averting a specific serious event.
No payer, clinic or health-system outcome is reported in the sources.
Aided clinicians reached 80.3% sensitivity and 91.4% specificity against 74.7% and 88.9% unaided.
No source reports an outcome for farmers or an accuracy figure for the fall armyworm model.
The Food and Agriculture Organization planned to feed Nuru's reports into its monitoring system, and no source reports that it did.
Patients waited 33.1 fewer minutes on average in the presurgical area.
Mean absolute error of planned case duration fell from 59.3 to 49.5 minutes.

McClure et al. report that eagle fatalities at the treatment site fell by 63% after automated curtailment, a measurable improvement in a conservation result. They state that deaths were not eliminated. Two U.S. Geological Survey statisticians reanalyzed the data and put the effect at 50%, with an interval that includes an increase, so the size of the effect is disputed.
No source reports a realized outcome for the operator, such as a permit, a cost or a legal risk avoided.
An attempt to enter the United States on another person's genuine passport was stopped and the traveler removed. Sources document no further threat beyond the document fraud.

CBP gained a verified first detection for a system then three days into use at Dulles, and its later releases report repeated catches. Gizmodo reported that CBP's annual report for fiscal year 2020 showed no impostor flagged at any airport that year.
Residents spent 29.6 fewer minutes on the ground after falls, and lies of more than an hour fell from 31% of fallers to none.
Time until staff assistance fell by 28.3 minutes between the baseline and real-time notification periods.

The sources report aggregate sensitivity, time to recognition and trial-level recognition rates, and none attributes a changed outcome to an individual patient. The randomized trial found no significant improvement in dispatcher recognition.
The sources report a capability study and a randomized trial that found no significant effect. No source documents an organizational event with an observed outcome.
Arisat's reported rise from 0.5 kg to 2.0 to 5.0 kg per plant is a measurable improvement in her harvest. It comes only from the developer's blog, with no independent source.
Breakthrough Listen recovered 72 additional bursts from an existing 400-terabyte Green Bank dataset without new telescope time.
The FRB research community gained a much larger burst sample (93 pulses in five hours) from the only known repeating FRB at the time.
Viz.ai data showed a median of 4.31 minutes from scan to specialist notification across 4,763 patients in routine use.
Hospital comparisons reported average reductions in door-to-puncture time of 24, 30 and 44 minutes for thrombectomy patients.
The ranger force's monthly snare removals rose from a reported two or three hundred to over one thousand. A chi-squared test confirmed that the predictions discriminated risk (p = 0.023).

Over one thousand snares were removed from a sanctuary that is identified as a site for reintroducing tigers. The paper states that each snare “represents the life of one animal potentially saved”. No source documents a change in an animal population.

Althingi replaced the first, manual stage of transcription with automatic drafts. Its transcribers graded 77% of the transcripts as Good, and about 640 hours of speeches had been transcribed by November 2019.

Vísir reported on 4 March 2018 that the recognizer was released under an open-source license, and no source reports that anyone outside Althingi used it or that the public gained a measured result from it.
Participants regained sustained control of everyday computer tasks at home. No separate societal outcome was measured.

A biopsy-confirmed stage 1A melanoma was excised, further tests found no spread and he is reported cancer-free. He calls it life-saving, but stage 1A is early disease and no clinician is quoted on prognosis. How long he would otherwise have waited is his own estimate.
Program-level figures; no identifiable individual event.
The council reports that it saved over £1m on 5,145 pothole repairs and that its pothole claim payouts fell from £1.6m in 2008/09 to £719; both are savings in cost.
Local aggregate without a discrete attributable event; complaints about potholes rose in 2023 to 2025.
The team tested necrosis detection on university servers with limited data. No source documents an improvement in clinical work.
No source documents a diagnosis or a treatment outcome for a patient.
Students in treatment schools scored 0.22 standard deviations higher in math and 0.20 higher in Hindi after 18 months.
The authors estimate a 50 to 66 percent increase in the productivity of school time, and J-PAL reports that the in-school model was twice as cost-effective as the earlier after-school model.
Median time in hypotension per patient fell from 32.7 to 8.0 minutes during surgery.

A woman with a recent transient ischemic attack received a diagnosis of atrial fibrillation on an electrocardiogram, with rate control and an anticoagulant. Later case reports describe deeper benefits, such as ablation with a defibrillator for ventricular tachycardia and a pacemaker for heart block. This rating covers the woman's case alone.
One identifiable person gained the first decoding of his own full words, about three times faster than his pointer typing. The decoding was limited to a 50-word vocabulary in research sessions.
Thorn's chief executive said that a child sold for weeks was recovered and removed from trauma. No independent confirmation of the recovery is among the sources.
Nurses with no echocardiography experience produced exams that cardiologists judged sufficient to assess left ventricular size in 98.8% of patients.
FDA reviewers expect that patients would gain faster access to echocardiography, but the sources report no realized outcome for society beyond the two-site study.
No individual outcome is documented.

Patrollers in Sirukam say that alerts let them go straight to a chainsaw's location, and local monitors told Reuters that the system made their work easier. The gain is speed of response; the one dated interception, in August 2019, ended with the logger escaping.

A patroller told Reuters that logging in the Sirukam area had stopped. The same report credits a wider enforcement crackdown, and a former logger quit in 2018, before the sensors, so no source ties the change to the alerts.
No individual beneficiary is identified in any cited source.
Indonesian authorities and INTERPOL obtained a capture, a conviction and a forfeiture. No cited source attributes any part of the result to an AI output.
One blacklisted vessel removed from Southern Ocean fishing. The contribution of any AI system is undocumented and the deterrent effect is not quantified.

Applicants with low credit scores whom a traditional model would reject got loans at lower rates. The authors of a 2026 peer-reviewed study report that their later finances improved. The effects are measured across Upstart's applicants as a group.
Sources describe aggregate access effects and later disparities; no societal outcome is measured.

An injured hiker stranded on a ledge at night was located and brought out the same night. Injuries are reported inconsistently (fractured back per NBC News, fractured hand per ABC7). Whether he could have called 911 himself is not addressed.
Middletown police say that three agencies responded to the automated call. No source reports time or resources saved for any of them.
No patient-management or clinical outcome was measured.
Laboratory-level accuracy was measured under study conditions, and the authors did not evaluate routine field operation.
No deployment at program scale is documented.
Senior students in schools with either version of the system scored 0.094 standard deviations higher on the ENEM essay than students in comparison schools.
The authors report that teachers moved time from routine grading toward individual discussions with students about essay quality.
Patients in the GI Genius arm had at least one adenoma found in 55.1% of procedures against 42.0% in the standard arm.
Endoscopists found 0.81 adenomas per colonoscopy with the program against 0.57 without it.
Median time to TB treatment fell from 11 days under standard care to 1 day in the X-ray arm, and 6 of 15 TB patients in that arm started treatment on the day of the visit.
Low-skilled drivers found customers with 7% less cruising time, and drivers are paid a share of fares.
Farmers scored 18–31% on diagnosis. The paper reports only a “slight increase” in extension workers' skill after two weeks and no yield or income outcome.
No deployment outcome for extension services is documented beyond the accuracy comparison.
Taxpayers who corrected claims are not individually documented; the page gives no individual outcome beyond the aggregate prompt count.
The ATO's own estimate of about $37 million revenue impact from one tax time, with no independent verification and no comparison with total collections given.
Protects public revenue at modest scale: prompts reached 7.5% of myTax users and the stated impact is an estimate.
The patient learned from her watch, and had confirmed by Holter, that her rhythm had reverted at 19:29. The report records no change in management, so the benefit is informational only.

A 400-year-old oak struck two cars at the hood. Eight people walked away with, at worst, two black eyes, a bump on the head and bruising. Laurence Sanderson and the Mirror call the braking life-saving. That claim rests on his account, and no telemetry or official assessment is reported. The second driver was unsure whether the brakes were enabled.

The sources document results in bacterial cultures and in mice and confirmation by independent laboratories. No source reports a real-world outcome that can be attributed to halicin, such as a treated patient or an approved drug.

FAO states that East African control operations prevented the loss of 4 million tonnes of cereal and 800 million liters of milk. FAO says that they protected the food security of 36.6 million people. The Times quotes FAO's USD 1.5 billion averted since February 2020. These are estimates for the whole operation, and AI data handling was one part of it.

FAO received up to 2,500 records a day with nearly 25 percent unusable. PlantVillage's AI removed the unwanted data. Over 240,000 records were collected in a year from scouts and citizens who could not have used the discontinued eLocust3 tablets.
No individually documented farmer outcome in the sources.

By his account and the footage as described, one driver was moved out of a wrong-way car's path at about 60 mph before he reacted. The other driver also swerved onto the median, so whether a collision would have occurred is unknown. No avoided injury or damage can be measured.

Thirteen patients had early, resectable lung cancer diagnosed and operated on. Seven were stage I and needed no further treatment. A survival benefit is plausible, and the paper does not demonstrate one.
The authors report that eight patients saw a pulmonologist on the day of the radiograph, before the formal report, which shortened the path to diagnosis.
Simulation results only. No live operational outcome is documented.
No collision avoided or reduced is documented.
No individual outcome is documented.
The study analyzed 7,651 patients who received real-time grading with accuracy similar to that of retina specialists, and 2,412 of them were referred.
Primary-care sites received results in real time. MIT Technology Review reported that the system sped screening when it worked, and it also reported image rejections and connectivity problems.
No source reports a vision outcome across the population.

The vendor reports that the system flagged a passenger staggering at the platform edge at Kyōdō on 3 April 2020 and that staff acted quickly to prevent an accident. The vendor's heading calls it a prevented fall, and no source says that a train was near, so the rating records a risk removed. The account comes only from the vendor.
The vendor reports that station staff felt more reassured, but no source counts alerts, false alarms or staff time.
IFAW and Baidu report that AI Guardian screened 360,000 images and led to removal of 7,853 illegal wildlife postings.
Removed listings are reported, but the extent of prevented transactions or protected wildlife is unknown.

In 2018 the winning algorithm's compartment produced 6% more sellable cucumber than the growers' compartment, and in 2020 every algorithm-run compartment reached a higher net profit than the reference. These are measured results in experimental compartments, and no grower's own accounts are reported.
Resource-use differences are reported per compartment; no wider outcome is documented.

One driver kept control of his car after swerving around a wild boar at 4 am and arrived unhurt. By his account the car straightened the swerve he had begun. Whether he would have lost control or struck the animal without that correction is unknown. No avoided injury or damage is measured, so a removed risk is not established.
The device output was hidden from the clinicians, so no site gained a diagnosis that it would otherwise have missed or delayed.

A young worker's band documented a tachycardia of 188 beats per minute. With her symptoms and a routine electrocardiogram showing Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome the next day, the band's record supported her referral for an electrophysiology study. Successful radiofrequency catheter ablation came 11 days after the recorded episode. The benefit to her was material, although the diagnosis itself came from the routine electrocardiogram.
The paper documents no use of the predictions by the Food and Agriculture Organization, the Desert Locust Control Organization for Eastern Africa or national control centers.
No field outcome is reported.
No litigant outcome is documented.
The processing-time claim is a developer statement at launch. No source measures a change in the court's work after the system came into use.
No source documents an effect on the quality or timeliness of tutela selection.
One man received a diagnosis of severe obstructive sleep apnea (3% ODI 33.6/h) from an incidental wearable signal. The paper reports no treatment or follow-up for him.
The 80% sensitivity for predicting exacerbation is a retrospective pilot result on five events, which the authors say is too small to generalize. No live alerting or changed care is documented.
Cohort-level association (mortality, organ failure, length of stay) without an individually attributable event.
The study reports adjusted associations across 590,736 monitored patients, not a discrete population-level event.
No individual outcome.
Shipping companies' cooperation grades are published but no change attributable to Whale Safe is documented.
No avoided strike or population effect is documented.

Shipping lines' cooperation figures (59% of the time in 2023, per KCBX, and 85 percent fleet cooperation in a 2024 BWBS report) cover the whole voluntary program. No source attributes a change in any operator's behavior to Whale Safe's ratings or report cards.

The 50 percent reduction in fatal strikes in the 2024 report and the 40% lower risk in 2025 against a 2016 baseline are modeled estimates by BWBS for participating vessels. Neither figure counts whales saved, and no source attributes either to Whale Safe.

A child separated from his parents for five years, living in an institution in another state, was identified and returned to his family. The sources describe the match as having “changed the lives of the child and his parents”.
Novice and low-skilled agents resolved 34% more issues per hour in the working paper estimate, and attrition among agents with under six months of tenure fell by about 10 percentage points.
The firm's agents resolved 15% more issues per hour on average after gaining access.

Each of 138,531 rural beneficiaries received five mobile-money installments of 8,170 CFA (women) or 7,000 CFA (men), according to Table 1 of the World Bank study. The developers' randomized trial reports gains in food security, mental health and self-perceived economic status. A beneficiary told NPR that he paid school fees with the money.
The Government of Togo delivered shock-responsive rural assistance without a social registry. The World Bank documents the model as a reusable case study.
The program reached 138,531 rural beneficiaries. The authors of the Nature evaluation report that exclusion errors were 4 to 21 percent lower than with geographic targeting.
No litigant outcome is documented.

The STF reports that every electronic appeal has been converted to searchable text on the day of receipt since December 2020, more than 10 million pages by May 2021. That is a convenience for staff; no time saving was measured, and the classifier was not in production.
No effect on case backlog or on litigants is documented.
The sources report classifier accuracy (80.6% recall) and aggregate use (over 200,000 people). None reports what followed a screening result for any child.
No source documents an outcome for the 60 participating schools or the other organizations beyond supplying participants.

Life-changing benefit to one identifiable person: standing, walking, stair climbing and independent home use restored after ten years of paralysis. Some recovery persists when the device is switched off.
The TCU reports an annual total for the program, and no source reports an outcome for any person.
The R$426 million is an annual total of control benefits that the TCU credits to Alice, and no source verifies a single event behind it.

The TCU reports R$426 million in public funds captured in 2021 through control actions supported by Alice, a cost saved for the public purse under its own measurement method. No source reports a change beyond that saving.

Households in selected wards were beneficiaries of the government's COVID-19 cash transfer. The PNAS authors say that disbursement began in mid-January 2021. The World Bank's status report records 49,000 beneficiary households as of 15 October 2021 without saying how many had been paid.

The National Social Safety Nets Coordinating Office stood up an urban registry within months through self-registration by mobile phone in the wards selected with the poverty map. The World Bank's appraisal document of November 2021 reports over 1.75 million registrations.

The sources report that the 1,163 selected wards, with over 20 million residents, were made eligible, and the 61.7% cut in inclusion errors is a simulation estimate. No source reports a realized change across that population.

The authors report that her phantom limb pain fell from 5 to 3 and that her stump pain fell from 6 to 0. Pain no longer interfered with her sleep. Her score on the EQ-5D-5L quality-of-life index rose from 0.23 to 0.63, and she had used the hand daily for more than three years. Karin says that the research “has given me a better life” and that she needs much less medication. It changed the life of one identifiable person, and the evidence comes from a single-patient study without a control group.
The discrepancy rate between emergency and radiology readings fell by 17% after the tool began.
Mean length of stay in the emergency department fell by 9 minutes.
No source confirms that anyone received or acted on an alert.
No source evaluates the accuracy of the forecasts or reports crop losses avoided.

A Nunavik translator says that she uses Google Translate or Microsoft Translator to look up uncommon words and to proofread and finds them helpful for quick translations. That is a convenience in her work, and other sources report errors that need a fluent reviewer.
The Government of Nunavut's and Microsoft's stated uses (healthcare communication, Office email, compliance with language law) are expectations without reported data.
Language-vitality effects are asserted by officials. VICE notes that Inuktut use fell from 72 to 65 percent between 2001 and 2016, without any link to the tool.
No pedestrian was shown at risk and no falling object occurred; the only documented trigger was a reporter's test, so no outcome is documented.

Jiefang Daily reports 995 door/window alerts handled from January to May 2021. An official said that visitors trying the devices triggered more than 80% of all handled events and that real events were far fewer. No efficiency measure is given.
Fewer patients died with baricitinib in COV-BARRIER and RECOVERY. RECOVERY confirmed lower 28-day mortality as its primary outcome in 8,156 patients.

ACTT-2 investigators reported a median recovery of 7 days with baricitinib and 8 days without it. A separate economic model estimated lower hospital costs. No source reports savings that hospitals realized.

WHO recommended baricitinib with corticosteroids for severe or critical COVID-19. That recommendation supports wider access to a treatment that reduced deaths in trials. Worldwide uptake and population-wide effects were not measured.

After two miscarriages, her hypoglycemia frequency and glucose variability fell on the device, and the pregnancy reached term with no significant complications. The source does not show that the device caused the live birth.

Two participants gained tablet control, web browsing and typing at home during research sessions. No source reports lasting independent daily use, so the gain is a measurable improvement in capability.
The study covers two participants in a pilot trial, and no source reports that the system reached anyone else, so no realized societal outcome is documented.
Residents and building managers receive timed alerts, but no individual outcome is documented.
The city proclaimed Lights Out Nights and Houston Audubon issues alerts, but no source measures a change in collisions at Houston buildings.
The collision evidence is a Chicago study co-authored by BirdCast scientists; Houston's own collision change is unmeasured.
Small: a new scholarly finding for Dead Sea Scrolls research published after peer review; no institutional change reported
Small: knowledge about the production of one manuscript; the sources claim no wider effect
ZEZEDU reports that students improved after one month of use and that internal benchmark scores rose by about 17 percentage points on average. The figures come from the developer's own data.
The developer states that automated grading saves teachers more than 10 hours a week. The figure has no stated method.
The study found a measurable improvement in sustained access to health information, without establishing clinical health gains.
ARMMAN improved engagement within its limited capacity for staff calls.

The abstract states that the watch prompted the patient's readmission for postoperative pulmonary embolism investigation and management, a serious condition caught in time. The outcome is not detailed, and details are limited to the abstract.
Visitors could see the composition complete for the first time in 300 years. The benefit is cultural and came from a temporary display.
The museum gained a research-based reconstruction and a public exhibition.
A 65-year-old man with Alzheimer's and a stroke a day earlier lay unconscious in two-meter grass after over 24 hours outdoors. He was found and handed to the ambulance service alive.
GOPR Bieszczady closed a search that police, dogs and ground teams had not resolved, in what it called the first such find in Poland.
No source reports a detection that stopped a train or a fall in accidents at the two crossings.
Optage reports comparable function at lower cost than laser radar, and no source measures a cost or safety result for Sanyo.
No individual outcome is documented.
51.5% of people told their AI result at once attended referral services within 30 days against 39.6% of those told after human grading.
No individual beneficiary is identified. Patients benefit only indirectly, through preserved hospital budgets.

The result mattered to the hospitals and to the federal budget. The audits cut R$2,381,663.00 from one auction and about R$5.95 million from another. The CGU reports that the five audits avoided R$8.33 million.
The effect is small at national scale, where federal purchasing is about R$119 billion a year.
Physicians identified and treated new heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, and his ejection fraction reached 55% at four months.
No source reports an organizational outcome for this case.
The case concerns a single patient.
No activation attributable to the model's output is documented, so no individual-level outcome can be assigned to the AI.
OCHA adopted the model as its trigger and computes estimates each cycle. The only documented activation (6 November 2025) was triggered by the observational wind-speed threshold.
Pre-landfall assistance in November 2025 (WFP reports 42,100 families) is documented, but not attributed to the AI model by any cited source.
Assisted reads improved sensitivity in 7.3% of biopsy images with cancer, and specificity rose from 88.45% to 89.50%.

An unconscious hit-and-run victim on a quiet road at night had an ambulance summoned within what Wanbao calls the golden hour. He had abrasions, a neck injury needing a collar and a suspected bleed at the back of the head. His girlfriend was told where he was. The family and the Wanbao headline call it life-saving. No clinician or official says so and a passer-by did reach him, so life-saving is not established.

The man had ventricular tachycardia at 166 beats per minute, which clinicians ended with electrical cardioversion. On verapamil he had no further complaints over four cardiology visits, so the case report describes a restored rhythm and a controlled condition.
The Belvedere adopted the reconstructions and showed them in its 2025 exhibition, according to its exhibition page.
The public can view a hypothesis of the colors of lost works. In a statement that Jing Daily quotes, Smola said that the result was surprising in areas where no knowledge of the colors existed.
The orchestra programmed a premiere that a sponsor funded and that was broadcast live, according to its concert page.

The project produced one new performance and recording of a hypothetical completion. Euronews states that humans chose and arranged the generated themes, and the BR-Klassik critic judged that the music sounds conventional.

The collaborating laboratories obtained a model that roughly doubles the structural coverage of the human nuclear pore complex scaffold. That is a material advance for the research programs of those groups.
A 70-MDa atomically resolved model covering over 90% of the scaffold is a durable public resource for nuclear transport research. The source reports no direct patient or population benefit.
No patient outcome is documented.
The proof of concept was tested and reviewed but not used in live bed management.
The code is open source but no reuse outcome is documented.

A 190,000-yuan transfer to a suspected romance scammer was canceled on the reminder, a serious financial loss for one person averted on WeChat's account. The man is identified only by surname and province, no police or bank confirmation is reported, and the case date is not given.

The authors report that both patients gained enough prosthetic control for activities of daily living, with the most recent follow-ups at 18 months and 2 years. The abstract gives no validated functional scores, so a lasting change is not established.
The report covers two patients at one hospital, and no source reports a realized outcome beyond them, so no societal depth can be established.
The individuals concerned are pool owners who pay more tax; no source reports a benefit to a person.
A measurable improvement in a result: the communes concerned received about 10 million euros of extra land-tax revenue for 2022, a figure that the Cour des comptes and the Sénat report restate.
No source reports an effect on tax fairness or compliance across society; the Cour des comptes judges that the scheme mainly demonstrates detection capacity.
Aggregate screening yield; the sources do not document any individual's outcome from this deployment, and treatment outcomes are not reported.

The deployer reports a number needed to screen of 44.9 for the portable X-ray and CAD strategy in six states in 2022, lower than the 49.0 to 388.5 of its other main case-finding strategies, a measured gain in case-finding yield.

The deployer reports that the deployment diagnosed 2,337 people with TB in hard-to-reach communities (2,481 in its tables) and that 97.3% started treatment, a measurable result in case finding. No source reports cure rates or effects on transmission.

The researchers measured mean herbicide savings of 28.4% to 62.4% across the three application timings, with weed control comparable to broadcast spraying and no yield increase. These savings lower the grower's input costs.
Less herbicide was sprayed in the trials, but no source reports a measured environmental outcome off the plots.

AIZEN reports that partner lenders financed more than 20,000 electric two-wheelers, which gave borrowers access to a vehicle and to credit. No source establishes higher income or lasting financial security for borrowers.

AIZEN reports that CreditConnect-EV lets partner lenders approve loans for electric two-wheelers at scale, which traditional scorecards made infeasible. No source reports the profitability of these loans or a fall in defaults.
AIZEN intends to lower pollution from transport. No source measures the emissions that the financed vehicles avoided.

One man received an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator for ventricular tachycardia and had curative surgery for a lung adenocarcinoma staged pT2a pN0. The authors judge that without the watch the cancer would likely have grown undetected and that curative surgery might not have been an option.

An unstated number of Android users near Alanya received a few seconds' notice of a quake that AFAD and the district governor said caused no damage or injuries. No recipient is reported to have taken protective action, and Hürriyet reported on 7 January 2022 that most users who posted about the alert said that they panicked.

The alert led physicians to recognize symptomatic bradycardia caused by a drug and to change her antibiotic, after which her heart rate returned to normal. The authors say that a potential adverse event was prevented, and they document no imminent event.
A correct molecular diagnosis replaced a misdiagnosis held since age four. The report documents no change in treatment.

Baidu reports round-the-clock sign language coverage and over 100 million views, but a Deaf professor's team found that the Olympic avatars lost or distorted key information and that Deaf viewers had difficulty understanding the signing, so the extent of any gain in access for Deaf viewers cannot be established.
Broadcasters gained continuous AI sign language output for a major event. The gain is service capability; comparative cost savings are not given.

The Swiss Plasma Center gained a controller that the authors call a notable advance for tokamak feedback control. The controller reduced the design effort for new configurations and made new droplet experiments possible.
No societal outcome beyond research progress is documented.
Patients examined with the algorithm received a correct diagnosis in 53.9% of cases against 43.8% without it.
Non-dermatology trainees diagnosed 54.7% of lesions correctly with the algorithm against 30.7% without it.
Chan survived a critical hemorrhage and regained an active life. Mayo credits AI with aiding diagnosis.
Patients with large vessel occlusion reached thrombectomy 11.2 minutes sooner after activation; functional outcomes did not differ.
Stroke teams cut door-to-groin and CT-to-treatment intervals across four centers.
Patients reached thrombectomy 11.2 minutes sooner after hospital arrival, in a treatment whose benefit depends on time.
Time from CT to thrombectomy start fell by 9.8 minutes.

A 57-year-old woman received an earlier diagnosis of large vessel vasculitis, which the authors call a potentially severe disease, after a chest CT had been read as normal. Treatment normalized her resting heart rate within ten days and her inflammatory markers within two weeks, and four weeks after treatment began she reported that she was well. This is a serious condition resolved in time.
The counts of flagged messages and blocked numbers are totals for all users, and no source documents a loss that an identifiable user avoided.
The sources attribute no measured change in scam losses to the app.
Recipients received cash, but no source reports a gain for recipients that the phone-data targeting itself produced.
The World Bank paper, drawing on GiveDirectly's 2023 synthesis, reports that the hybrid approach cost about half as much per added enrollee as in-person surveys alone, a cost saving for the program.
No population-level outcome is documented, and the World Bank authors found little targeting gain over random choice at the 80% cutoff.
The sources give accuracy measurements and a predicted date that agrees with independent re-dating of Athenian decrees. No source reports a verified result in scholarly use that came from Ithaca.

The reports establish a successful implantation, with the stimulator working normally and electrodes precisely placed. The trial team reports seizure reductions for the cohort, and no source gives this patient's own seizure outcome.

The stop removed 112 grams of crack cocaine and a semiautomatic pistol from a driver who, per a prosecutor filing that Forbes cites, had made nine trafficking-pattern trips. He pleaded guilty, received 48 months and agreed to a $34,000 forfeiture, per the court docket. The sentence was later commuted, and no source measures any effect on drug supply or violence.
The laboratory solved a structure that two years of standard methods had failed to solve.

Police seized 52.5 kg of explosive assessed as PETN-RDX before it was used. The minister said that the target was Istanbul. The court convicted five men of supplying weapons to a terrorist organization. The averted harm was potentially mass-casualty, although the reporting did not establish the specific plan.
The Hakkari police obtained a lead that produced a seizure, five arrests and five convictions. The minister counted it among 15 similar actions stopped that year.
The vendor describes customers whose social-engineering transfers of EUR 125,000 and USD 170,000 were blocked, a loss averted for each. No customer is named or independently documented.

The vendor states that a USD 500,000 (KSh 58 million) ATM fraud was stopped with arrests. It says that payments up to USD 850,000 were blocked before funds left client banks. The losses averted are serious if the account holds. Customers, banks and dates are not given.
The vendor gives no aggregate figure that a regulator has verified.
Independent groups at Texas A&M University and the University of Waterloo reused the enzyme in their own laboratory systems. The sources report bench work and no production deployment.

Near-complete degradation of post-consumer PET was shown only in the laboratory, and under larger-scale conditions FAST-PETase converted 18.1 percent of post-consumer PET in 24 hours. No source reports that any plastic waste was recycled outside a laboratory.
The randomized trial measured lower all-cause mortality within 90 days.

The National Audit Office reports the department's finding that the model is about three times better at identifying fraud risk than a random control sample, a measured gain in capability. The saving of £4.4 million over three years is small. Civil Service World reports that it rests on about 7,000 rejected requests out of more than a million advances a year.

No source reports an outcome for claimants or the public beyond the department's estimated saving. Referred claimants face added evidence demands. The department's fairness analyses showed that older claimants and claimants who are not UK nationals were over-referred.
No identified individual beneficiary. Villagers near three units are mentioned only as sources of daily notifications.

Researchers and forest department officials received tiger alerts 30 to 42 seconds after detection during the two-month pilot. Officials then sent text-chat warnings to village leaders, although the study says that these messages were not rapid.
No measured effect on human-wildlife conflict in the two-month pilot of 12 cameras.

A 29-year-old had his occluded artery reopened within 60 minutes of arrival and reports being alive with no deficits. The AI's share is the time saved in fast-tracking the cath lab team after EMS had already pre-notified the hospital and the team was ready. The thrombectomy was the treatment.
Dr Mehta states that the platform streamlines workflow and cuts time compared with the previous need to open scans at workstations.
Across US police-reported crashes, equipped vehicles had a 25% to 27% lower pedestrian crash risk and a 29% to 30% lower pedestrian injury crash risk.
Prosecutors' psychologists visited the 17-year-old and recommended urgent psychological support. No source reports that he received that support or any other outcome from the visit.
Officials checked the public statement within a day, and no weapon or plan was found. Police said that many such alerts prove to be jokes, so no prevented harm is established.
The paper reports extensive testing with visually impaired school children and the motivating need (three Irish Braille books). No identified pupil, date or measured gain.
Access to written Irish for the 4,701 school-age blind or visually impaired people cited from the 2016 census is the stated aim. No uptake figure is given.
The effects are averages across treated households, and no source documents a single household whose outcome changed because of an alert.

Across treated village councils under severe flooding, households were 12.7 percentage points less likely to have their home flooded and borrowed less after floods. In their four-season analysis, the authors find no effect on physical health.
The treating hospital described timely treatment of a severe infection, followed by recovery and discharge. The account does not establish a counterfactual life saved.
Nineteen women had breast cancer found at screening only because the AI flagged their examinations (269 cancers with AI against 250 without).
Patt reports that Lee confirmed a photograph of his mother at Bergen-Belsen and then found photographs of her extended family. Fixler found images of herself, her aunt and her cousin (NPR, BBC).

The BBC reports that Fixler's recognition doubled the number of identified people in one US Holocaust Memorial Museum photo, from three to six. No source records a formal archive update for the Lee photograph.
Two documented identifications among the millions of unidentified faces that the tool indexes are a small benefit to society.
No realized output of the algorithm is documented.
No recovered revenue attributable to VeRa is documented.
Targeted therapy for leptomeningeal disease started a week earlier and whole-neuraxis radiotherapy was avoided, with MRI improvement at two months. No source reports a survival benefit.
The slide-based prediction let the team choose a single rapid PCR test on limited tissue without waiting for sequencing.

One identifiable person communicated from a large vocabulary at conversational pace in research sessions. The team called the work a proof of concept. The authors of a 2025 study report that she still communicated mainly with a writing board or an iPad.
Women had measurable improvements in knowledge and reported care practices.
More high-risk patients attended their visits: the no-show rate fell from 36% to 33%, and from 42% to 36% for Black patients.
Schedulers focused limited call time on appointments that the model ranked as high risk.

One identifiable person communicated by decoded text, a synthesized voice and an avatar in research sessions at her residence. The paper reports no independent use outside those sessions. Her implant was removed in February 2024.

Yamagata University's Institute of Nasca reports a sixteen-fold increase in the discovery rate. The German Aerospace Center says that the survey achieved in six months what had previously taken decades.
The known corpus of figurative geoglyphs at a UNESCO World Heritage site nearly doubled, with 303 confirmed sites added to Peru's archaeological record.

Forest officials received the images in near real time and identified the individuals. The paper documents an investigation, not an arrest or prosecution, so the recorded gain is an investigative lead.

Protection of the reserve's wildlife from this gang is claimed through arrests only in the Clemson release, developer material and The Hindu's second-hand report. The paper notes a chital presumably poached before the second detection.
The submission lists a Korean horse-passport pilot and African rabies-tracking tests without a measured improvement in management.
Animal welfare, rabies prevention and reduced illegal trade are proposed effects. No source reports an observed outcome for any of them.

Clinicians diagnosed a pulmonary embolism with bilateral deep venous thrombosis and treated it with an anticoagulant after hospital oximetry had been normal. The source does not establish that death was imminent.
No German fatality data are documented.
No operator or site outcome is documented.

One identifiable patient had a diffuse glioma found during her scan. She had a biopsy the next day and was referred for immediate oncological treatment. The authors say that radiology typically needs days to report a scan and that treatment comes later still. The paper reports no follow-up and no changed outcome. The “saved a life” wording comes from the Anadolu Agency headline, and the authors make no such claim.

Crisis messages from patients were triaged by a crisis specialist within minutes on median. The paper reports no clinical outcome for any patient, and its authors list hospitalization and emergency department use as future work.

The company-authored study reports that the daily median time from message to crisis-specialist triage fell to 8 to 13 minutes, against over 9 hours on average before deployment. The baseline comes from Cerebral's internal analysis, and no independent party has measured either figure.

NRW police resolved an amok-threat email address to a person in fractions of a second. They identified 51 of about 100 shooting participants at about 20 minutes each, per the ministry and a Duisburg investigator. No comparison with conventional methods and no charges or convictions are reported.

Siegen's administration and public had the author of a threatened amok attack identified. The sources do not say whether the threat was credible, whether the person was charged, or what harm was averted.

Cao and colleagues report that PANDA found five cancers that the initial standard of care had missed, and that one patient then had surgery with curative intent for a 1.5 cm pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor.
PANDA exceeded mean radiologist sensitivity by 34.1% and specificity by 6.3% for pancreatic cancer identification in the evaluated cohorts.
Lives saved and benefits from population screening are possible later effects. The authors of an independent 2026 review report that no study shows an effect on stage at diagnosis or survival.
More veterans had precancerous adenomas found and removed: detection rose from 50.7% to 54.9% of colonoscopies at equipped facilities.
The VA raised a core colonoscopy quality measure by 4.2 percentage points without a change in withdrawal time.

Researchers in algebraic complexity gained new explicit decompositions, and Kauers and Moosbauer improved the 5x5 one within a week. The gains hold only over particular fields. Nature reports the 4x4 improvement for matrices “in a finite field”, and Kauers and Moosbauer give the 5x5 record of 96 multiplications over the field with two elements.

INEC's chairman reported that 2,780,756 ineligible entries (22.6% of new registrations) were removed from the register used for the 2023 general election. BusinessDay disputed completeness and regional balance, and the European Union observers reported that underage registrants remained in unknown numbers.
INEC obtained a cleaned register and identified 23 of its own officers for sanctions over multiple registrations.

The Philippine Red Cross reports that 78 households had their roofs and walls reinforced before landfall and that the kits mitigated the wind's impact. The claim rests on its own post-storm survey, which has no comparison group.
This was the first completed activation of the Philippine typhoon protocol. The final report documents lessons on lead time and weather constraints.
The 390 people reached are the households counted under the personal rating, and no source reports an outcome beyond them.
The authors measured how accurately the recognizer identified recorded test words. The paper documents no use of the system in the woman's real communication.
The study tested one person on a vocabulary of 13 words, so no effect on a population is documented.

A 17-year-old had posted videos with poison and an apparent cut. She was reached and counseled within about an hour of the alert and sent home with a small cut on her wrist. By her own account she wanted to scare her boyfriend. An averted suicide rests on the police's framing and is not established.
No detection, stop or avoided accident is documented.
Only stable operation in trials and later expansion are reported.
No individual outcome is documented.

Two studies of police-reported crashes across many states measured fewer rear-end crashes and fewer injury crashes for equipped vehicles, a change documented across the vehicle population. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration found that automatic emergency braking has reduced injuries and saved lives.
No organizational outcome is documented.
No individual outcome is documented.
No individual beneficiary is identified. Beneficiaries are public bodies and bidders in corrected tenders.
Material to the audited municipal and state bodies: 53 of 60 alerts answered and notices worth R$91,723,011.31 corrected, per the court's own aggregate figures.
One month of tenders in one state. The statement gives no estimate of money saved, only the value of notices corrected.
The trial measured a substantial increase in completed diabetic eye exams. It did not establish improved vision or prevention of blindness.
The authors report lower mortality after deployment. The comparison comes from a model built on historical data, with no randomization.
Screen-reading workload fell by 44.2% (61,248 against 109,692 readings).
Cancer detection rose from 5.0 to 6.4 per 1,000 women screened, and sensitivity rose from 73.8% to 80.5%.
Women in the AI group had 338 cancers found at screening against 262 in the control group, and the extra invasive cancers were mainly small and node-negative.
The screening service needed 61,248 screen readings in the AI group against 109,692 in the control group, a 44.2% reduction.
Newly implanted patients had better speech intelligibility at 3 and 12 months. Experienced users had median gains of 10% in speech scores.
The authors report that the FOX approach was equivalent or superior in “hearing performance, comfort, and resources”.
The Brussels studies each come from a single center, and no source reports an outcome across a population.

A man with a 99 percent stenosis of the left anterior descending artery had it stented after the software flagged a 72 percent probability of severe narrowing. The manual reading of his exercise electrocardiogram had rated his risk moderate and would have left him to drug treatment and follow-up. The cardiologist put his chance of an acute infarction at 8 in 10. He said that the stent removed the risk of sudden death. The man left hospital, and his symptoms resolved. The hospital's headlines call the case life-saving. The harm was prospective, and the only account comes from the hospital that built the model, so a life saved is not established.
Students achieved a measurable improvement in immediate post-test scores. The trial did not establish a lasting change in their capabilities.
The course demonstrated a teaching format with better post-test results. This rating rests on the same trial as the student rating, and no separate organizational study is cited.

A boy who had chronic pain for three years received a diagnosis and corrective spinal surgery. He had also come to drag his left foot and had stopped growing taller. In November 2024 his mother said that he is a new kid now. No source shows that the surgery saved his life.
Owners of detected pools bear a cost, and no individual beneficiary is documented.

The DGFiP estimates that the tool added about €40 million in local property tax for 2023. The Cour des comptes reports €4.4 million in recurring revenue and €5.7 million in back-tax from the 2022 pilot. In Dordogne alone the public-finance office is recovering tax on about 1,500 pools.
About €40 million nationally is small against total property-tax receipts. The DGFiP's own report gives 140,000 pools in one section and more than 120,000 in another.

No individual beneficiary of the controls is identified. The people directly affected are those investigated. By Amnesty's reading of UDK's figures, 54% to almost 90% of opened cases per model ended with no further action.

UDK's own 2023 figures give 135, 36 and 72 cases with revenue from three models against 412, 511 and 491 requested cases. No amounts are given, and the authority says that yearly figures are not directly comparable.

No societal outcome is reported beyond the cases with revenue that UDK counts for itself. The 2023 figures give no amounts, so the extent of any gain to public funds cannot be established, and Amnesty's report questions whether the models are effective.

The developer reports that municipal pilots inspected more than 30 km of water mains. The project gathered 109,350 labeled records, which passed a quality check within the government data project. No source establishes that pipeline failures were avoided.
More reliable water service and fewer leaks are intended, and no source measures effects on public resources or safety.
vivo reports offline speech, vision and sign language assistance that expands communication and access to information. Its user figures do not establish lasting outcomes for every user.
vivo asserts a 90% reduction in cloud energy use. No source measures the total energy use of devices and cloud or the net environmental effect.
Students assigned to the chatbot were four percentage points more likely to earn an A or B in the course.

An identifiable infant received a definitive molecular diagnosis of a disorder that the authors say frequently causes early death before age two. A multidisciplinary meeting the same day coordinated gastrostomy tube placement and long-term goals. The treating team's 2026 series reports that the result informed family planning, started disease-specific supportive care, changed her level of care and helped her move to palliative care because of the poor prognosis.

In this single case, preliminary results were returned on 10 January 2023, five days after the sample was shipped on 5 January 2023. Genomic panels and a microarray sent from the institution were still pending and were anticipated to take longer than one month. The report does not say what became of those tests.
The website offers accessibility functions, and no source reports a measured change in use, understanding or health for its users.
The submission asserts that the chatbot reduces staff workload. It gives no comparison of workload before and after the launch.
Universal access and lower emissions are intended effects that no source measures.
No individual rescue or beneficiary is attributed to the maps in any cited source.

The developer and a World Bank specialist report that responders received building-level damage maps within hours or minutes, where such an assessment would typically take weeks. The developer reports that teams found damaged areas that they had been unaware of. No responding agency gives its own account.
No downstream effect on rescues, shelter siting or reconstruction is documented. The maps covered part of the affected zone after imagery became usable on 9 February 2023.
The safety net led to 204 breast cancer diagnoses among women whose examinations radiologists had first read as normal.
Detection was 6.7 per 1,000 with AI against 5.7 per 1,000 without, with a recall rate that did not rise.
No outcome is attributable to the AI. Contributors using the AI-assisted editor mapped more slowly, and the OSM wiki reports that the editor was disabled.
No outcome is attributable to the AI. Responders' use of OSM data is documented, but no source ties it to AI-derived features. The AI-assisted editor slowed mapping.
No outcome attributable to the AI is documented.
The trial measured a 22% cut in the share of trip time ridden on sidewalks across 456 trips, a measurable change in rider behavior. No crash or injury outcome was measured.
No outcome for Spin or the city is documented beyond compliance behavior.
No identifiable individual outcome.

The court gained lawyer-verified transcripts of Constitution Bench hearings on a trial basis. It had published them for 9 of 25 hearings by May 2023 and for almost ten main matters by December 2023, and by February 2024 it published them regularly within days of a hearing.

Transcripts were published on the court's website for public and academic use, for only a minority of hearings in the first months. By February 2024 they appeared regularly within days of a hearing, and a judge reproduced part of one in the Electoral Bonds judgment.

A 6 mm cancer was treated at an early stage with surgery and a short radiotherapy course. Dr Lip states that cancers picked up under 15 mm carry around 95% survival. The benefit is potentially life-saving but not demonstrated as such for this patient.
Across the 10,889-woman evaluation Mia helped find 12% more cancers. The University of Aberdeen statement says this would not put more women through additional tests.

A 25-year-old man received a diagnosis of atrial fibrillation confirmed by electrocardiogram. He then had cardioversion to sinus rhythm and four weeks of anticoagulation. The report does not describe the outcome as life-saving.
By the owner's own account the diagnosis led to treatment and his dog's near-full recovery. The account is self-reported and unverified by any clinician. The beneficiary is one owner and one animal.
One identifiable person avoided a £60 fine that she considered wrongly issued. She also saved the time of drafting an appeal, which she said that she found hard to articulate.
Five adults without respiratory symptoms had early-stage lung cancer diagnosed, four with curative surgery. The authors report positive outcomes but no survival data.
No individual outcome is documented.
The IRS gives no results from the AI-selected examinations and GAO reports only officials' pilot claims.
No revenue or fairness outcome is attributed to the models.

Carers reported peace of mind (13 of 14). Clinicians gained event counts for people who cannot report seizures. Linköping clinicians report that the recordings were clinically useful in 8 sessions. No cited source documents a treatment change or an injury avoided for an individual.

The Cornwall trust's evaluation reports that Nelli recorded 707 possible seizure events in 14 people who could not tolerate EEG, 247 of them unheard or unrecognized by carers. The authors report that this allowed for improved communication and care planning. No measured change in staffing, response times or incidents is reported.
No individual beneficiary.
No deployment reported.
No attributable event.
Participants given ChatGPT hints showed a 17.00 percent learning gain from pre-test to post-test, significant against a no-hint control.

The prosecutor's office reported that a gang responsible for at least eight accredited violent robberies was detained and brought before the Noveno Juzgado de Garantía. Four adults went to preventive detention.
Prosecutors state that the tool replaces review of hundreds of case files with a short list of proposed links.
No avoided blackout or deployment is documented.
No grid operator use is documented.
The council reports that proactive support prevented homelessness in a high-risk cohort. The groups were not randomized, and AI’s separate effect is unknown.

The government reports that the approach increased prevention effectiveness by 65% and avoided 96 homelessness cases from June 2023 to January 2025. No source supplies sample sizes or an independent evaluation.
Weighted kappa against the expert panel rose from 0.297 to 0.419 for lobular inflammation and from 0.414 to 0.563 for ballooning in 1,481 cases.

Dubai Culture and Khalifa University report that the completed pilot detected known excavation areas, predicted new zones and produced a geospatial knowledge base. No source reports that excavation has confirmed a new find.
Heritage conservation is an intended benefit, and no source measures avoided damage or wider effects on preservation.
In one DIII-D session the controlled plasmas tracked a stable path with fewer disruptions and higher time-integrated beta. The authors describe this as a path toward scenarios relevant to ITER.
No outcome beyond fusion research is documented.
Participants with ChatGPT finished writing tasks in 40% less time, with quality 18% higher.
The Rubin Observatory and the DiRAC team at the University of Washington obtained a real-data validation of the linking software before the ten-year survey began.
One potentially hazardous asteroid about 600 feet across was added to the catalog. The sources state that it poses no foreseeable risk to Earth, so the benefit is knowledge of the object.
CSE reports that some farmers in Sehore, Vidisha and Bhopal valued faster payment of claims than before. That is time saved. Other farmers in the same districts report lower claims than their losses.

District officials told CSE that claims for similar crop losses had become more consistent since the technology came in. They gave no figures and also called the process opaque. The PIB states that settlement is faster and gives no figures.

The PIB reports adoption by nine states, and CSE later reports twelve. No source documents an outcome at scale. Down To Earth reports that payouts in three districts fell sharply between 2018 and 2024.
No individual beneficiary.
Bradford Museums exhibited the painting as a possible Raphael and extended the display “due to popular demand”.
The attribution is not accepted by scholars or institutions.
The screen predicted a specific candidate, Tmem81, that the laboratory then validated genetically and biochemically. This was a measurable research result for that group.

The laboratory identified a fertilization factor that vertebrates share and that male zebrafish and mice need to be fertile. This advances a long-standing open question. No source reports a clinical application.

In the laboratory, the participant controlled grasping, including self-feeding, through AI decoding of his movement intentions, alongside spinal stimulation and sensory feedback. This restored meaningful abilities in one person. The study does not isolate the contribution of every component.

One identifiable person regained conversation with family and colleagues. In the 2026 follow-up the team reports that he used the system for more than 3,800 hours at home without researchers. He communicated nearly two million words and kept working full time.

Treated students' math growth scores exceeded those of controls by 0.36 standard deviations on the same 35-question test, a measured gain in a test score reported in the second version of the preprint.
The paper gives a marginal cost of about $5 per student, which is a cost estimate; no source reports a saving or a changed result for the school network.

Across millions of driverless miles, the sources report fewer bodily-injury claims and injury crashes than the human benchmark (zero bodily-injury claims against 1.11 per million miles; 81% fewer injury crashes in the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety study), a lower risk of injury. The sources do not show how serious the avoided injuries would have been.
Waymo faced fewer property-damage liability claims per mile than the human baseline (0.78 against 3.26 per million miles), a measured reduction in claims against the operator.
No individual beneficiary is documented; the comparisons are aggregate rates.
Mathpresso describes real-time question solving and personalized study support that give students convenient access to tutoring. No source measures learning gains or lasting effects on inclusion.
Students with GPT-4 finished each legal task faster, saving 11.8% to 32.1% of their time.
The sensitivity and specificity come from historical records, and no patient was referred for follow-up because of the software.
ICE reports several confirmed rescues of children from active abuse and 14 positive contacts. The number of rescues is unstated.
ICE and NBC News report that more than 100 leads went to field offices and partner countries. They report that active abusers were arrested in the United States and Canada.

Cal Fire's Mount Laguna station received a verified alert at about 3 am. Its crews extinguished the fire at under a quarter acre. Cal Fire intelligence specialist Suzann Leininger said: “It's getting us time to react in a faster manner”.

The area around Mount Laguna was spared a larger fire. Captain Yeary judged that it “could have been a devastating fire”. Battalion Chief Slumpff judged that it would probably have reached hundreds of acres. No source measures what would have happened without the alert.
No individual beneficiary or per-party outcome is documented. The STF says that its figures do not refer to decisions taken with AI help and do not allow calculating time saved.

The tool mattered to the court's screening work. In one controversy VitorIA identified at least 247 appeals with similar legal questions. The STF describes this as the technology taking part in organizing and identifying patterns in its case flow. The STF does not quantify time saved.
No source reports an outcome for society. The STF says that finding the similar appeals did not determine the result, and no cited source says what happened to the 247 appeals.

The surgeons said that without urgent surgery he faced hemiplegia, speech loss, blurred vision or death. After the guided awake operation, computed tomography showed no remaining clot. The fire was held to 52 acres and the evacuation lifted the same afternoon (Cal Fire record; KBAK), a risk removed for the neighborhood. The claim that the camera network detected it first comes only from ALERTCalifornia's founder via Microsoft.

Dubai Municipality reports that cement tests that took four days now take eight minutes, and that daily samples rose by 650 percent. These figures describe time saved and throughput, and no source reports a change in test quality or in construction outcomes.
Lower exposure of staff to hazardous materials is intended. No source gives a measured exposure or health result.

General benefit. No cited source documents a forecast office using the GraphCast Lee run in its products.
General benefit. No public-safety decision is linked to the run in any cited source.

U.S. Customs and Border Protection obtained a seizure and two arrests from a flag that Mayorkas said took 1.4 seconds. The Department of Homeland Security leads both its artificial intelligence page and its 2024 roadmap with the case as its example of artificial intelligence in use.

Consultants below the average baseline score raised their task performance by 43%, and those above it by 17%.

Participants who are identified by number report that they identified airport gate numbers, recognized their surroundings, located a dropped hair tie and read a check on their own. The results are small and self-reported, and the authors of the same papers document frequent errors.

Studies reported time savings of 3 to 80 minutes, and experts estimated 10 to 30 minutes, with contours of similar quality.

The seafarer received a diagnosis, rate control and aspirin at sea, a diversion to port and confirmation in the hospital. He was repatriated without complications. The authors say that the service “has the potential to save lives”. The report documents no life-threatening complication.
The CIRM duty doctor could base a rhythm diagnosis and a diversion decision on an electrocardiogram trace in addition to the symptoms. The report gives no measure beyond the single decision.
The council reports less time spent on call wrap-up and executive-assistant tasks.

Planning officers spend less time processing consultation responses by hand. The earlier rise in public participation came from digital engagement before these AI tools.
Farm staff scored gill disease weekly by conventional means. The authors report no farm decision that the activity signal changed.

Farmer Jin Shutao is named, but no personal outcome beyond the farm figure is reported.

In SmartMore’s model-training example, IndustryGPT achieved 100% accuracy and recall, compared with 50% accuracy and 66.7% recall for manual training, alongside shorter training time. Production revenue remains unmeasured.

A drone observed that the man was asleep. By the department's own report, the robot then stood between him and the gun. The two-hour standoff ended in an arrest with no injury reported. No source shows that officers would otherwise have been hurt.
