The Cour des comptes states in December 2025 that efficiency gains in control programming are established. It gives no measured gain in results attributable to data mining, and it reports that these controls accounted for 13.8% of the tax and penalties recovered in 2023.

Ramage, who is blind, now reads street signs, menus and scenes on his own and relies on the glasses each morning, which restores a capability that he had lost. He says that buses once drove past him at a stop and that the glasses bring a level of comfort that he had not had in years.
NOAA requested a voluntary speed reduction for an endangered species over a defined area for about 15 days. No source shows that a strike was averted or that vessels complied.

Drivers slowed by an average of 6.30 km/h and 5.06 km/h at two sites when the sign showed a warning. The department's claim of 31 percent fewer fatal crashes is not shown in the project summary, and a lower speed limit for roadwork may also have cut deaths.

Coates was critically ill, too sick for a transplant, and facing hospice care. He reported that he began responding to the drug regimen within one or two weeks, later received a stem cell transplant, and reached full remission five months after that transplant. Arbaugh reports computer control “just like anyone else can”. He still used the implant 28 months after surgery, and an earlier report puts his use at about 10 hours a day. Conley operates a robotic arm for light switches and doors.
No organizational outcome reported.
Seven users as of July 2025; no population-level effect.

Neither ESTsoft nor Gimhae City reports a measured change in the work or service of the senior centers.
AIforPet reports pilot feasibility and user acceptance. No source quantifies an improvement in the management of horses.
Benefits to horse welfare and to sustainable livestock management remain potential.

Restoration and carbon-market benefits are prospective effects of maps that had not been produced.
HSE University reports that its language-model pipeline built a database of 38,000 hazard events from eight million articles, and that specialists checked the records.
No emergency decision, loss reduction, or avoided disaster is attributed to the database.

No source measures wider adoption of renewable power or lower emissions as a result of this pilot.
China Mobile reports that the monitored area grew from 120 to 330 square kilometers and that detection and enforcement efficiency improved by 45%.

China Telecom reports more than 900 million kWh in annual energy savings across its network. It also reports that deployment and operating costs for the energy system fell by 90%.
China Telecom reports a cut in CO₂ emissions of more than 500,000 tons. No source checks the supporting calculations independently.
The research prototype is intended to improve the speed and coverage of monitoring, and no source reports a measured comparison.

AI transcribes broadcasts from ten radio stations for monitoring. Transcription quality, staff time saved, and resulting newsroom improvements remain unquantified.

Monitoring problematic content is intended to support peace and linguistic inclusion; those downstream effects are not measured.
The developer reports that the deployed agent outperformed human dispatchers in comprehensive control evaluations. No source gives the size of the improvement.
More renewable energy and lower emissions are intended benefits, and no source measures their extent.

Participants use generative AI in practical tasks and custom GPT development. The extent of any learning improvement caused by AI is not measured; attendance and satisfaction describe the overall program.
Custom GPTs and AI-assisted research or knowledge products are intended to improve UN and civil-society work. No separate workplace productivity or quality improvement is measured.

No source reports injury severity or how long the improvement lasted.
The council reports time savings in deployed administrative workflows. No source shows a lasting change in its services.

No source reports a realized outcome for an individual officer or resident. The thumbs-up feedback has no response count or baseline, and councillors report that some callers hung up without help.
Transport for West Midlands used the sensor observations to choose and build road-layout changes, which improved its ability to find and treat sites with many near misses.
Near misses at one Coventry junction fell from 17 to 2 over equal two-month periods after the refuge was built. The sources give no data on collisions or injuries.
The vendor reports that AI use in the campaign cut cost per impression by 9% and cost per click by 5%, a cost saving with no reported effect on votes.
Teachers in the ChatGPT group saved 25.3 minutes a week on lesson preparation for Year 7 and Year 8 science.
Schools saw lesson preparation time fall by 31 percent with no evidence of lower resource quality in a blind expert review.

An identifiable family received a definitive molecular cause of their son's death. They used it for IVF with preimplantation genetic testing to avoid a recurrence of the lethal disease. The infant himself died at two days of life.
Primary care physicians aided by the device reached 91.4% sensitivity for skin cancer referral against 82.0% unaided.
The patient regained active thumb and wrist movement that conventional rehabilitation had not produced. The gains are small, and pain did not consistently improve.
The paper reports a single case with no follow-up and no use beyond the treating group, so no realized societal outcome is documented.

The public learned which tool made the robocall, and the FCC later relied on Pindrop's analysis, with an NBC News report, for that fact in its proposed fine. No source shows that the analysis changed an outcome.

After 14 years of complete quadriplegia the patient regained the ability to drink and eat by himself through the glove that the interface drove. He could also hold objects without the interface.

Silent, extensive, reversible ischemia from three-vessel disease was found and treated with quadruple bypass in an asymptomatic man. The authors' learning point is that such ischemia can end in exercise-induced sudden death. The counterfactual is not established.
Reported reductions in case-note, assessment, and supervision writing are task-time savings.
Workers report less documentation effort and time. Improvements in service users’ health or care are unmeasured.
Staff report less time spent on meeting notes and other tasks.
Staff report improved focus, productivity, and work experience. The duration of those improvements is unknown.

Caers reports that the AI-planned campaign appraised the high-grade zone of the deposit in about eight months, and the project then moved into development. No source quantifies how much of this result the AI produced.
Knichel survived a life-threatening hemorrhage and resumed her work and activities.
Nader, Farritor and Schilliger shared a $700,000 prize announced by the organizers on 5 February 2024. Farritor had earlier won the First Letters prize for the first word.
The readable text validated the University of Kentucky program behind the virtual unwrapping, which Seales described as a 20-year dream.
A previously unknown Greek philosophical text became readable. Nature reports that the method paves the way to deciphering the rest of the scrolls.
Referrals rose 15% in services using the chatbot against 6% in control services, with rises of 179% for nonbinary people and 29% for ethnic minority people.
The reports count train stops and crossings, and no source counts injuries avoided by crews or passengers.

The council reports that the job-advert tool saves drafting time and makes adverts uniform.

The council reports that selected data-retrieval tasks took 90% less time and cost in the pilot than in the existing system. Savings across deployed services are unmeasured.
The sources report a task-level test result for the council and no outcome for any social worker, child or family. Improved child safety is not established.
The public-road pilot repaired a small number of cracks, which shows a new operational capability.
Fewer potholes, injuries, and dangerous maintenance exposures are intended. No achieved safety benefit is described.
SES Water reports that leak run times fell by up to 40%, and Haskoning ties the 40% figure to critical burst mains. Both figures come from the utility and its vendor.
No source reports a measured volume of water saved or a leakage reduction attributed to the alarms.

Te Hiku Media built a te reo Māori transcription capability that it reports at 92% accuracy, up from 86% in its first model. The University of Auckland reports that the tool performs very well in Te Hiku's broadcasting. Both accuracy figures originate with Te Hiku, and NVIDIA, its tooling vendor, repeats the 92% figure.
Benefits to te reo speakers and learners are the stated aim; no cited source measures them.
Participants completed small daily identifications without asking family. They rated descriptions 2.76/5 for satisfaction and 2.43/4 for trust on average. The app could not read text.
The app launched across federal entities, and no source reports a measured improvement in human-resources processes.
Better experience and access for employees are intended effects of the app, and no source measures them.

By his own account Franklin reached a VA emergency room during an insulin-pump failure with blood glucose at 670. No clinician, hospital or official source confirms the emergency or the drive.
The risk categories were measured on retrospective data, and no hospital used the score to change care.
Crowdworks AI reports that real-world tests using 1.05 million data samples showed over 90% translation accuracy.
Crowdworks AI reports over 90% user satisfaction in field tests in more than 20 languages. No source measures injury prevention.

A stage I colorectal cancer inside a 1 to 1.5 cm adenoma was removed through the endoscope without surgery, according to all three reports. The sources do not demonstrate a survival benefit for this early-stage cancer.

PTI reports only that police “prevented a possible suicide by a student hailing from the Jhunjhunu district” within a week of the launch. The sources give no account of what the student posted, their condition when reached or what officers did. So the outcome is not established.
AgileSoDA reports 76% less floor-planning time, from more than a week to roughly a day, across partner deployments.
Higher-value work and professional development for engineers are expected consequences, and no source measures them.

Students of tutors with the tool were 4 percentage points more likely to pass session exit tickets (62% to 66%), and 9 points for lower-rated tutors. The authors found no significant gain on end-of-year tests.
The provider's tutors with the tool prompted students to explain more often and gave generic praise less often, at about $20 per tutor per year.
Two county lines dealers were convicted, according to the force and the court outcome. Officers seized 99 wraps of crack cocaine and two knives.

Treated students scored 0.31 standard deviations higher overall and 0.23 higher in English after six weeks. This is a measured gain in test scores, and independent authors who re-analyzed the trial put the overall effect at 0.310 standard deviation (95% confidence interval 0.176 to 0.444).
The 1.5 to 2 years of business-as-usual schooling is a cost-effectiveness comparison made by the authors. No source reports a change that the schools themselves realized.
Ant reports that an annotation system that it developed with specialist doctors improved annotation efficiency by 50%. No clinical outcome is reported.
The submission reports wide uptake and a 98% satisfaction rate. It does not quantify a change in any user's health or experience of care.

The study compares forecast skill on past periods and reports no realized gain for ECMWF or for any user of the forecasts.

Patients on 60 mg once daily gained a mean 98.4 mL in forced vital capacity over 12 weeks, while patients on placebo lost 20.3 mL. A father and his daughter received a genetic diagnosis of long QT syndrome and preventive beta-blocker treatment against sudden arrhythmic death. No cardiac event was imminent.

Residents near Auburn gained from a fire that crews put out before it spread. The sources do not quantify the damage avoided at this fire.

An active yoga demo is described, but no practitioner health or fitness outcome is reported.

Workshop participants and visitors are intended to understand AI better through practical use and interactive demonstrations. The extent of any learning or confidence improvement is unmeasured.
Technology providers are intended to receive useful feedback from public interaction with their applications. The sources do not establish the extent or consequences of that feedback.
Students using either tool produced legal work of higher graded quality and were 50% to 130% more productive on five of six tasks.

wolfSSL received a reproducible report of a heap use-after-free in a path that parses private keys. It merged the fix within days, in pull request 8139 on 1 November 2024, and shipped it in 5.7.6 on 31 December 2024. The maintainers listed it among bug fixes, and the release's Vulnerabilities section does not include it. wolfSSL's vulnerabilities page lists no Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifier for it. The vendor itself says that the exploit conditions “don't seem easy to meet”, so the benefit is material and bounded.
No source reports a benefit to a person.
No source reports gas saved, revenue or another gain for the Turkmen operators.

UNEP lists eight mitigated leak sources in Turkmenistan. For the Lebap pipeline it estimates that 16,000 tonnes of methane escaped before the repair and reports that satellites detected no further emissions after 7 March 2026. The total avoided emissions across the eight cases are not stated.
Students with ChatGPT scored 73.12 against 65.54 on the virtual reality skills test, and students with low spatial ability scored 70.20 against 55.41.
The model did not contribute to diagnosis or treatment.
No organizational outcome.
No attributable event.
The ministry reports that an AI assistant gives real-time reporting guidance. No source measures an improvement in inquiry handling or reporting work that is due to the assistant.
The patient gained audio access to printed recipes in her kitchen. The report documents this single use within a broader rehabilitation plan. The gain is small.
The case report describes one patient and reports no aggregate or population outcome.
Attendees could ask the multilingual assistants for help. No source measures a change in their access to event information or in their experience of the summit.
Organizers planned for the digital humans to assist visitors and host proceedings. No source measures a saving or a service improvement that the digital humans produced.
The trial enrolled healthy volunteers and measured safety, pharmacokinetics and serum neutralization; no person obtained a therapeutic benefit.
The authors report a completed phase 1 and recommend a phase 2 trial; no source reports a realized organizational outcome.

The limited public rollout gives visually impaired passengers audible arrival alerts, automatic unlocking, and voice-first controls, and the company said that they took more than 200 rides in Wuhan. No source measures whether the passengers gained lasting independent mobility.

Design businesses are intended to improve design efficiency and product development.

KT Commerce says that partial use in 2024 saved 8,300 hours. The developer reports 80 percent less negotiation time and average profit margins 5 to 6 percent higher. A higher margin is a measurable business result, and no outside party has checked it.
ZTE reports that the model cut the time spent writing reports at the Changjiang Hydrological Bureau by approximately 30%.
No flood-response decision or prevented loss is documented.
31.7% of people referred to the AI program reached the weight, activity or HbA1c goal, the same share as with human coaching.

The council reports that the assistant saves the occupational therapy team 15 minutes per conversation. No independent source has checked the developer's larger figures.
A deputy therapy manager obtained needed equipment information while a colleague was on leave. No care outcome is documented.

By her mother's account the girl's displaced distal radius fracture was set and cast within days of the urgent-care visit that had sent her home in an ace wrap. The orthopedist's remark that untreated displacement would likely have needed surgery comes only from the mother. No clinician, clinic or record is public. She had already asked for the films for the primary-care physician. Whether the outcome would have differed without Grok is not established.

NBC News reported that she overturned the eviction and avoided roughly $55,000 in penalties and more than $18,000 in overdue rent. No cited source gives the ruling. Court records show that her later petitions in the same case were denied in November 2025.

On six farms, shipping age fell from 182.3 to 176.7 days and the grade 1+ share rose from 35.3% to 37.7%. Income per head rose from 100,000 to 118,000 won, up 18%. On Pocheon farms, sow accidents fell from 3.1% to 2.7% and piglets per sow per year rose from 18.3 to 19.2. These are the agency's own before-and-after figures.
Reduced need for farmers to stay in the barn is mentioned but not measured.

Investigators returned 18 confirmed local diagnoses to families, including 11 new diagnoses and seven rediscoveries. In an interview with NBC News, a patient describes the value of receiving an explanation after years of uncertainty. Changes to treatment or health outcomes were not measured.

The vessels went from 2.7 to 1.3 high-severity close encounters per vessel per month between the first three months and months 10 to 12, a measured improvement in a navigation safety result for their operators.

Improved public participation is intended. Its extent is unknown.

The treatment enabled the couple to have a child after years of infertility.

One convicted robber who had evaded a long sentence was returned to custody. The reports give no evidence of any further harm prevented, so the public benefit is small and diffuse.

The Şırnak police turned a software flag into a large seizure and three remands, per the DHA and İHA reports. A measurable result for the unit.

The recovered Rs 79.5 lakh belonged to the courier's employer, R K Enterprises, and the reports describe no outcome for Ajmal Bhai Ganesh himself.

R K Enterprises got back Rs 79.5 lakh of the Rs 80 lakh taken at gunpoint, which police described as the entire amount. Delhi Police's North district cleared, within about 24 hours, an armed robbery whose video had gone viral. Both accused are in judicial custody under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Arms Act, and police recovered the pistol.
Two men who had watched cash couriers and used a firearm were arrested. The reports give no evidence that further robberies were prevented, so the extent of any public benefit cannot be established.

Practitioners' work exhaustion and interpersonal disengagement scores fell by 0.44 points on a five-point scale with scribe use.
Time spent on notes fell by 0.36 hours a day per practitioner.

No source traces the extra revenue to an effect on the public, such as funded services or a smaller tax gap.

The Shandong University group obtained a reusable fiducial. With its AI-designed domains, the group solved three structures between 2.29 and 2.50 angstroms for proteins that are otherwise difficult targets for cryo-electron microscopy.
The four structures are public in the Protein Data Bank, and no paper by another group reports using the Trimbody, so no wider outcome is reported.
Adenomas, which are precursors of colorectal cancer, were found and removed in 52.3% of patients with the system against 36.1% without.
The hospitals raised adenomas found per colonoscopy from 0.8 to 1.2.
PixVerse reports that creator @nerdsoul used PixVerse to gain 300,000 followers and 210 million views in two months, a measurable gain in creative reach.

The bureau closed one complaint in 24 hours and used the case to publicize its sound-camera enforcement. Its claim that the cameras “greatly raise the success rate” of tracking noise vehicles comes without figures.

Heelan gave the kernel project a report and a fix, and its maintainers committed the fix on 25 April 2025.

Inflammatory attacks that had recurred since early childhood ceased on colchicine after a genetically confirmed diagnosis. The benefit is life-changing, tempered by a documented transaminase rise from self-dosing before medical supervision.

SQLite fixed the flaw in version 3.50.2 before any public report of exploitation. Its release log describes the fix: SQLite raises an error early when the number of aggregate terms in a query exceeds the maximum number of columns.

By the user's own account, ten-plus years of near-constant tingling, tinnitus and chronic fatigue were “largely resolved” within months of a doctor-approved methyl B complex. The bureau and the Wuri Precinct police solved a case of repeated burning that had stalled because the motorcycle plate was too faded to read. The system's alert sent inspectors to the site, and its video supplied the core evidence. The bureau presents the case as proof that its “smart technology city” enforcement works.

DeepGestalt changed medical geneticists' testing decisions in 17 cases involving 19 patients. The full article reports confirmed diagnoses in selected cases, such as an intragenic ANKRD11 deletion found after an inconclusive exome.
The authors claim “a more efficient test strategy”, and Cases 5–7 illustrate targeted testing after insurance barriers to broader sequencing. No source counts tests avoided or time saved.

The author and the patient report that ChatGPT helped them find and summarize articles quickly, and that they relied on those summaries when deciding on additional support. The author states that the case cannot show what the chatbot-informed additions contributed to the regression, so only the help with information is rated.
No organizational outcome.
Single case.

Sesp-MT's Ciosp located a woman wanted since a 19 June 2024 warrant and tracked her in real time, per the 14 July 2025 reports. It handed her to the 1st Military Police Battalion, which arrested her. A measurable result for the unit.
One person with an open drug-trafficking warrant was taken into custody. The reports give no evidence of any further harm prevented. So the public benefit is the execution of a warrant.

South Wales Police identified in Cardiff a man wanted on a 2012 European arrest warrant and remanded him. It reports 10 arrests from 50 app searches. A measurable result for the forces, on their own figures as relayed by the press.

One man wanted for drug dealing and assaulting an officer with a weapon in Poland was taken into custody for extradition proceedings. The reports give no further harm prevented. So the public benefit is the execution of a warrant.

One identifiable patient, the poster's mother, had an 18-month cough with internal bleeding that doctors had warned could become fatal. After the medication change her daughter reported her “finally healing”. Material for one person. It rates below life-changing because the recovery was in progress. Nothing beyond the daughter's post documents the diagnosis or the outcome.
Ivaldo's family obtained the recovery of his body and certainty about his fate after ten months of searching. The search recovered a body, so no life was saved.

CNSAS Piemonte ended a ten-month search that had involved ground teams and helicopters of the Guardia di Finanza and the fire service. The Club Alpino Italiano says that manual analysis of the drone photographs would have taken weeks, and CNSAS told bluewin that it would have taken months.

The filmmaker reports that AI let him animate archival photographs of events with few surviving film records, which he says that he could not have done without it. The film received awards in 2025, and no source measures any effect on viewers.
The study tested how well the categories separate risk and did not test whether treatment guided by the software changed outcomes.

An 83-year-old woman was transferred rapidly for thrombectomy of a major stroke, and she describes a very good physical recovery with no serious disabilities. The sources do not show how much of the speed came from the software.

NHS England associates the tool with a 64-minute reduction in door-in-door-out time at primary stroke centers. The Lancet Digital Health study reports that thrombectomy rates rose from 2.3% to 4.6% at the 26 hospitals that implemented the software.

A confirmed diagnosis replaced “anxiety” on her records and lets her plan care and equipment. The condition is progressive and has no treatment. The gain is certainty and appropriate management, and her prognosis is unchanged.
The developers report that OneAstronomy scored higher than comparison models on astronomy tests of knowledge and reasoning. No source reports a new astronomical discovery.
The developers intend wider public access to astronomy learning, and no source measures an effect on learning.
Space-weather protection and other public benefits of the research are planned, and no source reports them.

A tumor that had gone undiagnosed for three years, producing glucose readings of 30 to 40 mg/dL, was found and removed. Dani says that he is cured, and COPE reported on 7 August 2025 that his symptoms had gone. He and the outlets call it life-saving (El Español: episodes that could have ended in fainting, brain damage or death). That counterfactual and the whole chain rest on his own account. No clinician who treated him has spoken.

A woman in her 70s living alone, with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, was in acute crisis at 2 a.m. She got a check-in call, a police visit that night and protective hospital admission the next afternoon. The city and the headlines call it life-saving. No attempt was reported, so the counterfactual is unproven. Her guardian said that having the robot beside her had been a great support to her.

The sources report no time, cost or capability that the city welfare office gained from this case. Its director cited the case as a model and the city kept the program, and neither of these is a realized outcome for the office.
Disconnection counts are aggregates. No measured reduction in fraud losses is documented.
The Department of Telecommunications and the operators report disconnections and blacklisted points of sale, and no source evaluates the outcome.
Aggregate competition results. No specific attack or deployment outcome documented.
Open-source maintainers received disclosures. No fix is individually documented in the sources.

Holli went to the emergency room after the chatbot told her to go. She says that staff told her that the bite's tissue was dying or dead. The diagnosis, treatment and outcome were not reported, so the benefit rated is the visit itself.
The developer and mayor attribute an early warning and avoided escalation to the system. No alert log, causal comparison, or estimate of avoided damage supports a depth assessment.
The municipality’s response is documented, but the sources do not measure any reduction in response time, staffing, or cost attributable to AI.

The curl maintainer reports that the project merged about 50 bugfixes from the first list and removed code that carried a potential overflow. By 23 December 2025 he counted several hundred bugs fixed from AI analyzer reports.
curl is widely deployed, and the sources report no averted incident that affected users. The merged fixes are described as mostly small mistakes.

The first detection came from a human stock check and a manual review of closed-circuit television (CCTV) footage.
Researchers can obtain species lists close to expert lists (F1 0.84) without listening to every recording.
A functioning multilingual, 24/7 advice channel handles roughly 50 conversations weekly. This is a reported service-capability gain.

Officers report less processing work, and the council reports shorter waits for applicants. No improvement in decision quality or realized housing delivery is demonstrated.
HMPPS estimates that the tool saved probation officers about 266,667 hours across more than 1,600,000 meetings, and pilot officers reported a 73% cut in write-up time.

The store operator gained a flagged concealment and footage that led police to the perpetrator within hours. Three attempts were exposed over four and a half months of unstaffed night trading. The operators say shrinkage did not rise. All figures are the companies' own. No loss amount or recovery is reported.

A 16-year-old whose farewell letter led police to assume an acute psychological crisis was located in the Bahnhofsviertel within a day. She was returned to psychiatric care. The police frame this as averting danger to life and limb. But no source reports what would otherwise have happened, so life-saving is not established.

The Frankfurt police recorded the first confirmed success of a system in use since July 2025. The police president and the interior minister cited it as validation. netzpolitik.org reported in April 2026 that it was still the only success among a low double-digit number of searches. The operational gain is modest.

Severe aortic stenosis found before non-cardiac surgery, changing perioperative management and leading to TAVR.

Rosie had been given months to live after surgery and chemotherapy. Her largest tumor halved, and she regained mobility by late January 2026. ABC News reported on 22 June 2026 that she was still running and playing. A checkpoint inhibitor given at the same time confounds the partial response. The cancer later returned, and Conyngham chose to have her euthanized.

The UNSW RNA Institute made what Thordarson called the first personalized cancer vaccine designed for a dog, from sequencing by the Ramaciotti Centre for Genomics. They describe the case as a milestone. Conyngham's spin-out GAMGEE raised a $4 million seed round in August 2026 on the strength of the case.

An appendix that the man says the CT showed close to rupturing was removed on 3 December 2025. The pain was gone and he went home the next day. A doctor commenting in the thread said that severe abdominal pain in a younger patient almost always gets a CT. So life-saving is not established.

The Reserve Bank of India declined a Right to Information request for the number of mule accounts identified, and the only monthly figure is one that a news summary attributes to the central bank's governor.
No source documents a fraud loss avoided.

The camera trace gave Thanh Xuân Ward Police and the Traffic Police a direction of travel and images for the search. The police present the case as evidence of the new system's value.

Buffalo River Aviation's aircraft “landed safely without incident”, in the airport spokeswoman's words. No damage is reported, and the operator said that the aircraft returned to service the next day.
No source reports use of the app or a realized benefit to its users.

Tân Hưng Ward Police and the Criminal Police Division cleared a burglary by a masked intruder in under 72 hours. Seven outlets carried the case as the police's demonstration of the AI camera system.

The man was alone and hidden from view in cardiac arrest. The automatic alerts brought family members, who began cardiopulmonary resuscitation about 6–7 minutes after the collapse. He left hospital neurologically intact, and the authors present the outcome as life-saving.

The Finance Minister reports that assessed customs collections rose by over US$300 million from January to 17 July 2026, a 17.5 percent uplift over declared values. That is a measured gain in the Ghana Revenue Authority's result. The government counted it itself, and traders dispute it.
No source traces the added revenue to public spending or other wider effects.
An overnight planned repair with zero delay minutes. The comparison is a defect the same month that cost over 10,000 delay minutes and a day of disruption.
Passengers were spared delay from this fault. The scale of avoided disruption is not quantified.
No individual outcome is documented.
ProRail says the cameras help it see and prevent incidents sooner. No incident, detection count or delay figure is published.
Fewer trespass incidents and disruptions are the stated aim. No before-and-after data are given.

Citizens Advice received specific design input. Its contribution to service capability and performance remains unassessed.
The victim recognized the fraud and filed a police complaint after ChatGPT's response. The Deccan Herald says that this stopped further payments. The reports describe no recovery of the money.
No source documents an outcome beyond the single complaint.
The police registered a case. No source documents an outcome for any organization.
Cambium reports no evaluation by a named customer and no measured gain in research quality.
Patients in the app group walked 62.77 meters farther in 6 minutes and lowered systolic pressure by 4.11 mmHg more than controls.

The hospital reports that the alarm brought staff to a patient in ventricular tachycardia who had stopped breathing, and that resuscitation within the golden time restored heartbeat and circulation before the patient went to intensive care. That is a serious condition resolved in time. Survival to discharge and neurological outcome are not reported, so the sources do not establish that a life was preserved.
The child received a diagnosis of enlarged parietal foramina, and genetic evaluation identified a CDC42BPB variant. The authors state that the diagnosis facilitated earlier therapeutic interventions.
No organizational outcome is reported.
The report describes a single case.

The fire service learned of the crash at 11:04, about 46 minutes before the operator reported the helicopter missing, and the call came from the crater area. No source shows that the head start changed the search, since the helicopter's GPS track also ended near the crater.
All three occupants died; the fire department reported on 18 February 2026 that their bodies had been found in the crater.
No wider outcome is documented.
The patient was saved by his ICD. The wristband's detection was retrospective and produced no alert or treatment.

The patient died as expected under palliative withdrawal. The detection was retrospective and no alert, treatment or resuscitation followed.
The authors present the case as a step toward real-world detection of unwitnessed arrests. No deployment or survival outcome exists.

The temple's loss was the contents of one first-floor office of about ten square meters (staff lockers, some tea, sweets, incense and joss paper). The main hall, statues and worship areas were untouched. The temple stayed open in the run-up to the Lunar New Year crowds. The fire bureau credited the reinforced-concrete structure and its own eight-minute arrival for the containment. A conventional smoke alarm sounded as well. The share attributable to the AI alert is an earlier warning, whose length the sources do not settle.
Correct identification of a subtle subpulmonic effusion informed on-site management. But the patient refused transfer and left against advice.
No organizational outcome reported.
Single case.

In one operation the force detained 325 suspects across 14 provinces and closed 69 dealer groups. All 325 were remanded. The sources give no comparison with operations before AVCI, so the size of the gain to the force is not measured.

Forest staff intercepted armed groups inside a tiger reserve more than once. In February 2026 they seized nine guns and more than 20 bows and arrows. These interceptions matter to the reserve's wildlife.

By his account Vohra was unconscious at freeway speed, and the truck stopped on the shoulder without hitting anything. It then took him to an emergency room, where he was stabilized overnight. He and the Indian outlets call it life-saving. The only source is his post. No vehicle data and no police, emergency-service or hospital record has been published. The sources do not name the freeway, the software version or the hospital.

Burns was trapped upside down in a submerged cab in the river at night with an air pocket of about four inches. Crews pulled her out with bruises only, which is a life preserved. Burns told WKRC that a Life360 service on her mother's phone also called police, so the sources do not establish that the watch's call alone brought the crews.
Clermont County dispatch received the automated call and stayed on the line with Burns. No source reports time or resources saved for the sheriff's office or the fire district.

Operators are reported to have diverted gas to newer infrastructure, and no gain to them, such as recovered gas or an avoided cost, is reported. The operator is unnamed, and Eni did not confirm the closure of this source.

The Chemical Engineer reports that this was the largest source mitigated in 2026, after an estimated 1.7 million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent released since 2023. It is one case among about 41 confirmed, and the operator has not confirmed it.
Ynet reports that one drone was intercepted and no injuries occurred in the 2 March 2026 launches. No official source attributes any interception to Iron Beam.

The Israel Defense Forces said on 12 March 2026 that Iron Beam had not been used in the war. Officials later described limited use and partial coverage, and a senior defense official said on 9 August 2026 that the one delivered system was still not operational.

GitHub closed a remote code execution hole in its git push pipeline within hours of the report. The fix reached github.com at 7:00 pm UTC on 4 March 2026. GitHub also shipped patches for six GitHub Enterprise Server release lines. Wiz earned what GitHub calls one of the highest rewards in the history of its Bug Bounty program. The loss avoided is hypothetical. GitHub's forensic investigation found that no other account had triggered the code path, and CISA records no exploitation. Wiz wrote that its data showed that 88% of GitHub Enterprise Server instances were still vulnerable when it published on 28 April 2026, so many self-hosted servers stayed exposed. NIST rates the flaw High (8.8).

Two identifiable participants typed sentences of their own choosing at up to 22 words per minute. One of them has anarthria and only eye movement left. The typing happened only in research sessions. The paper lists independent use as future work, so the gain is a measurable improvement in a capability.
The outcome is reported for two trial participants in research sessions. A typing rate faster than that of earlier decoders is a research result, and no source reports a realized change for society.
The study compares AI and expert labels on images that experts had already classified. It reports no labor saving, no adoption by a monitoring program and no changed research decision.
No changed conservation decision or wildlife outcome is documented.
Pooled trial data showed a statistically significant rise in the adenoma detection rate for most systems.

An 18-year-old who had taken rat poison was reached within 12 minutes of Meta's 8:58 pm alert. He was treated in hospital and reported stable. Officials said even a slight delay could have been fatal. No clinician is quoted and the rodenticide is not identified. The life-saving reading rests on the police account.
Aggregate verification statistics; no source reports an outcome for any person.

NHC's verification measures lower Atlantic track errors for the DeepMind ensemble than for NHC's official forecast at 12 to 72 hours, and an independent analysis found that it was the most accurate guidance of the season, a measurable gain in a tool that NHC used in operations.
